svg.title: A long conversation made of light
svg.desc: A large passive reflector in the foreground is paired with a fan of successive observation cards and an orbit diagram, conveying repeated measurements across time. AI-assisted illustration, not a photograph or a to-scale reconstruction.

g.text: ONE RETURN IS A MEASUREMENT. MANY REVEAL A PATTERN.
A LONG CONVERSATION MADE OF LIGHT
AI-assisted illustration · not a photograph · explanatory scene
